projectDescription: A Java console application that converts between currencies in real time using the ExchangeRate-API.
keyFeatures: Support for USD, PEN, ARS, COP, and any valid ISO 4217 currency code
Interactive console menu for selecting source and target currencies
Layered architecture: DAO, Model, Service, and entry point
Built with Java 17 using java.net.http.HttpClient and Google Gson
publicApiSurface: ConversorDAO(String base_code, String target_code, double conversion_rate)
